job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experience accountant, qualified/ part qualified in ACA/ ACCA/ CIMA (or equivalent) or qualified by experience; and enjoy taking ownership of management accounts, getting into the detail and making sure the numbers are accurate?
This is a great opportunity to join a well-established business in a varied, hands-on accounting role, working closely with the Financial Controller and wider finance team.
You’ll be involved in producing monthly management accounts across the businesses and head office, alongside reconciliations, journals, VAT, cash reporting and supporting the year-end audit.
 
What will you be doing?
  • Supporting the production of monthly management accounts
  • Preparing accruals, prepayments and month-end journals
  • Completing balance sheet and nominal ledger reconciliations
  • Investigating variances and ensuring financial information is accurate
  • Completing cashbook postings, bank reconciliations and cash reporting
  • Maintaining management accounts spreadsheets and supporting schedules
  • Reviewing overhead postings and processing adjustments
  • Preparing the VAT return
  • Overseeing expenses and associated accounting entries
  • Supporting invoice processing and payment controls
  • Supporting the annual budgeting process
  • Providing information and analysis for the annual audit and tax return
 
What are we looking for?
  • Part-qualified/ fully qualified ACA / ACCA/ CIMA (or equivalent) or qualified by experience (QBE).
  • Someone who takes ownership, gets into the detail and takes pride in getting things right.
  • Organised and accurate, with the ability to manage competing priorities and month-end deadlines.
  • Proactive and inquisitive, happy to investigate
  • A confident team player who communicates well with colleagues across the business and enjoys finding better ways of doing things.
 
If you’re interested in this Accountant opportunity and would like to know more, please apply or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Credit Controller
job.description:
Are you an experienced Credit Controller who enjoys taking ownership, building relationships and successfully collecting outstanding debt?
This is a great opportunity to join the finance team of a well-established business, working closely with the Finance Manager and colleagues across the wider organisation.
It’s a hands-on role with plenty of variety. You’ll take ownership of the day-to-day credit control function, proactively managing customer accounts and collections, alongside cash allocation, reporting, invoicing and reconciliations.
 
What will you be doing?
  • Taking ownership of credit control across the business
  • Proactively chasing overdue payments by phone and email
  • Building positive relationships with customers to resolve payment queries
  • Allocating incoming payments
  • Reconciling customer accounts
  • Carrying out credit checks on new and existing customers
  • Producing accurate credit control and aged debt reports
  • Highlighting risks, disputed accounts and areas requiring action
  • Producing manual invoices and maintaining accurate cashbook records
  • Working closely with internal teams to improve collections and cash flow
  • Supporting other members of the team when required
 
What are we looking for?
  • Previous experience within credit control
  • Confidence chasing outstanding payments professionally
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate data-entry skills
  • The ability to organise and prioritise your workload
  • A proactive approach to resolving queries
  • A friendly, confident and professional communication style
 
If you’re interested in this Credit Controller opportunity and would like to know more, please apply or contact Julie Warner at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Are you an experienced Financial Controller? Do you enjoy being trusted to make your own decisions and having the freedom to improve processes; if so this is a really exciting opportunity.
You’ll join an established, stable family business in Wellingborough as their sole Financial Controller, taking full responsibility for finance and working directly with the owners. It’s a broad, hands-on role with plenty of autonomy and the opportunity to make the finance function your own.

Financial Controller (ACCA, ACA, CIMA, AAT or QBE)
Wellingborough, Northamptonshire • Established Family Business • Autonomous Role
Key Responsibilities
  • Full ownership of the finance function
  • Month-end reporting
  • Cash flow management and forecasting
  • P&L and balance sheet reporting
  • Producing the trial balance
  • Providing clear financial information to the business owners
  • Accruals and prepayments
  • Maintaining the fixed asset register
  • Posting journals
  • Purchase and sales ledger
  • Bank reconciliations
  • VAT returns
  • Running BACS payments
  • Credit control
  • Reviewing existing finance processes and implementing improvements
  • Identifying opportunities to improve controls, reporting and efficiency
  • Supporting the owners with financial information and commercial decisions
About You
  • ACCA, ACA, CIMA Qualified (or equivalent)
  • Experienced in managing a broad, hands-on finance role
  • Comfortable being the sole finance person and taking full ownership
  • Confident communicating financial information to business owners and non-finance colleagues
  • Able to work independently and use your own judgement
  • Naturally interested in improving processes and finding better ways of doing things
  • Practical, organised and approachable
  • Happy working in an established business where the focus is on stability, quality and doing things well
Other Information
  • On-site parking
  • Friendly, family-business environment
  • High level of autonomy
  • Genuine ownership of the finance function
  • Scope to shape processes and make improvements
  • Direct working relationship with the business owners
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to become an important and trusted part of an established business. You’ll be given the autonomy to take ownership of finance, make improvements and get involved where you feel you can add value.
If you’d like to find out more, please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation. I look forward to hearing from you.

job.title: Finance Business Partner
job.description:
Are you a commercially minded accountant; qualified, part-qualified or QBE, who enjoys getting behind the numbers and influencing business decisions?
We’re recruiting a Finance Business Partner for an established multi-site organisation for their head office in Northampton. You’ll work closely with senior operational stakeholders, providing financial insight and challenge to improve performance and support commercial decision-making.

Finance Business Partner
Northampton
The role:
  • Partner with senior operational stakeholders
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting and reforecasting
  • Analyse monthly performance, highlighting risks and opportunities
  • Deliver variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial insight
  • Support revenue, profitability and cost management
  • Provide financial modelling to support commercial decisions
  • Turn complex financial information into clear, actionable recommendations
About you:
  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA studier/qualified, or equivalent experience (QBE)
  • FP&A, commercial finance or finance business partnering experience
  • Financial modelling and forecasting skills
  • Confident with Excel
  • Able to communicate with senior stakeholders
  • Commercially minded with good analytical skills
Benefits:
  • A comprehensive employee benefits package
  • Pension scheme
  • 25 holiday allowance
  • Ongoing learning and professional development
Interested? Apply today or contact Julie at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation.
